banned.name: Endosulfron
banned.note: ad-Interim order of the Supreme Court of India in the Writ Petition (Civil) No. 213 of 2011 dated 13th May, 2011 and finally disposed of dated 10th January, 2017

banned.name: Sodium Cyanide
banned.note: banned for Insecticidal purpose only S.O 3951(E) dated 8th August, 2018

restricted.name: Aluminium Phosphide
restricted.note: Pest control only by Government bodies or approved pest control operators under expert supervision, except 15% 12 g tablets and 6% tablets; 10- and 20-tablet tube packs of 3 g tablets banned (G.S.R. 371(E) 20.05.1999; S.O. 677(E) 17.07.2001)

restricted.name: Captafol
restricted.note: Foliar spray banned; seed dresser use only; 80% powder for dry seed treatment only for export (S.O. 569(E) 25.07.1989; S.O. 679(E) 17.07.2001)

restricted.name: Carbofuran
restricted.note: All formulations except 3% encapsulated granule (CG) stopped from use (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Chlorpyriphos
restricted.note: Banned for use on ber, citrus and tobacco (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Cypermethrin
restricted.note: 3% smoke generator only through pest control operators, not the general public (Delhi High Court, WP(C) 10052/2009)

restricted.name: DDT
restricted.note: Public health use capped at 10,000 tonnes a year; agricultural use withdrawn except under Government supervision (S.O. 295(E) 08.03.2006; S.O. 378(E) 26.05.1989)

restricted.name: Dimethoate
restricted.note: Banned on fruits and vegetables consumed raw (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Fenitrothion
restricted.note: Banned in agriculture except locust control in scheduled desert areas and public health (S.O. 706(E) 03.05.2007)

restricted.name: Malathion
restricted.note: Banned on sorghum, pea, soybean, castor, sunflower, bhindi, brinjal, cauliflower, radish, turnip, tomato, apple, mango and grape (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Mancozeb
restricted.note: Banned on guava, jowar and tapioca (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Methyl Bromide
restricted.note: Only Government bodies or approved pest control operators under expert supervision (G.S.R. 371(E) 20.05.1999)

restricted.name: Monocrotophos
restricted.note: Banned on vegetables; 36% SL discontinued, sale only to clear existing stock (S.O. 1482(E) 10.10.2005; S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Quinalphos
restricted.note: Banned on jute, cardamom and sorghum (S.O. 4294(E) 03.10.2023)

restricted.name: Trifluralin
restricted.note: All uses except in wheat prohibited from 08.08.2018; aquatic-toxicity caution required on label (S.O. 3951(E) 08.08.2018)
